from solution import snake_to_camel


def test_issue_example_android_tv():
    """Example 'android_tv' converts to 'AndroidTv'."""
    assert snake_to_camel("android_tv") == "AndroidTv"  # 'android'->'Android' + 'tv'->'Tv' = 'AndroidTv'


def test_issue_two_words_hello_world():
    """Convert the given snake case string to camel case string."""
    assert snake_to_camel("hello_world") == "HelloWorld"  # 'hello'->'Hello' + 'world'->'World' = 'HelloWorld'


def test_issue_single_word_no_underscore():
    """Convert the given snake case string to camel case string."""
    assert snake_to_camel("hello") == "Hello"  # 'hello'->'Hello' = 'Hello'


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Convert the given snake case string to camel case string."""
    assert snake_to_camel("") == ""  # empty = empty


def test_issue_three_segments():
    """Convert the given snake case string to camel case string."""
    assert snake_to_camel("one_two_three") == "OneTwoThree"  # 'One' + 'Two' + 'Three' = 'OneTwoThree'


def test_issue_single_letter_segments():
    """Convert the given snake case string to camel case string."""
    assert snake_to_camel("a_b_c") == "ABC"  # 'a'->'A' + 'b'->'B' + 'c'->'C' = 'ABC'


def test_issue_many_segments():
    """Convert the given snake case string to camel case string."""
    assert snake_to_camel("my_snake_case_string") == "MySnakeCaseString"  # 'My' + 'Snake' + 'Case' + 'String' = 'MySnakeCaseString'


def test_issue_first_word_capitalized():
    """Convert the given snake case string to camel case string."""
    assert snake_to_camel("foo_bar") == "FooBar"  # 'foo'->'Foo' + 'bar'->'Bar' = 'FooBar'


def test_contract_returns_string():
    """Function converts to camel case string."""
    assert isinstance(snake_to_camel("android_tv"), str)  # type str = str


def test_contract_output_has_no_underscore():
    """Function converts to camel case string."""
    assert "_" not in snake_to_camel("android_tv")  # 'AndroidTv' has 0 x '_' = no underscore


def test_contract_input_unchanged():
    """Function converts the given string without changing it."""
    word = "android_tv"  # 'android_tv' = 'android_tv'
    snake_to_camel(word)
    assert word == "android_tv"  # 'android_tv' == 'android_tv'
